scope: Retained Linux save evidence review plus fresh isolated Linux current-code-equivalent compass/transition/draw measurements during native CI; production source unchanged.

source_evidence.save_game: game/main.gd:1176-1192 snapshot then synchronous store.write_state; timer ends before notice and save-file hash event.
source_evidence.store_write_state: game/save_store.gd:106-151 validates/serializes current world, reads existing save, verifies/writes current+backup files and renames.
source_evidence.production_autosave: game/continuity.gd:192-207 calls same synchronous save every 30 seconds and on application pause/focus loss.

save.interpretation: 716.739ms is total instrumented snapshot+store call, not a 717ms snapshot. The store residual is 660.488ms; no individual disk/JSON attribution was measured. The subsequent event file hash lies outside the timer, so this is not full input-to-resume latency. Frequent probe checkpoints are not evidence that production saves occur equally often.

compass.measured_scope: navigation.compass_entry only; candidate check1, entity visits0, BFS searches0 in village. Current29microseconds vs retained a6 42/48microseconds, separate runs, no timing regression observed.
compass.full_monster_traversal: REMOVED_FROM_GATE_SEARCH_BY_MAP_INDEX; observed village count0; broader all-map per-frame CPU profile NOT_RUN in current retained runs.

first_post_transition_tile_decode_and_ca.scope: Linux X11 softwareGL first main._draw CPU submission, one sample each; no native first playable frame claim. Cold map includes all draw work, not separately isolated PNG decode.

compass.source_preservation: Current navigation and WorkAssets core cache logic recovered to original a6 exact source/bytecode; enter_map clears Work tile cache only when map ID changes. This static preservation is not a new runtime timing PASS.

correctness_limits: No new save-corruption defect observed in these retained successful saves/restarts; performance remains an identified gap.

The initial pilot core route failure is preserved. A normally learned compass fallback proves a legal escape and later attack-spell continuation, not that the originally blocked cave walk exit has been retested successfully.
